state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country at the company's request today? (answer in EUR)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for IT hardware bought by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q5: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride with trade-fair luggage today? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q6: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-05-15? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the monthly mobile allowance that applies to: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-05-15?

passages.source: HB-35 §1 | Memo: monthly mobile allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the monthly mobile allowance in HB-37. The IT reviews the monthly mobile allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Claims for the monthly mobile allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Communication policy: mobile phones'.

passages.source: HB-37 §1 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-28
passages.text: This policy sets the monthly mobile allowance for all employees. The IT reviews the monthly mobile allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Claims for the monthly mobile allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Communication policy: mobile phones'.

passages.source: HB-28 §1 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-09-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-37
passages.text: This version set the monthly mobile allowance for all employees. The IT publishes worked examples of the monthly mobile allowance on the intranet. Each claim for the monthly mobile allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-35 §2 | Memo: monthly mobile allowance exceptions — Exception for field engineers | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
passages.text: For field engineers, the monthly mobile allowance is 50 EUR per month instead of the standard amount. The IT reviews the monthly mobile allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Questions about the monthly mobile allowance go to the IT, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-37 §4 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-28
passages.text: Group exceptions to the monthly mobile allowance are published in HB-35. The IT publishes worked examples of the monthly mobile allowance on the intranet. Managers confirm claims for the monthly mobile allowance before payment in the next payroll run.
